Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using FLAG-tagged ZUFSP. While 'GlyGly on K' was used as a variable modification in the search parameters, this was for the identification of ubiquitinated interactors rather than a dedicated ubiquitylome enrichment workflow (no diGly antibody enrichment was performed).

organism: human proteome reference data (including splice variants) from Uniprot
cell_lines: Flp-In T-REx 293 cells or Flp-in T-REx 293 cells with stable 3xFLAG-ZUFSP integration
scope: the tagged ZUFSP construct was immunopurified together with its binding partners and analyzed by mass spectrometry
The supernatant was incubated with prewashed magnetic anti-FLAG M2 beads (Sigma Aldrich) for 2 h at 4 °C.
For MS analysis, bound proteins were eluted with 200 µg/ml 3xFLAG peptide (Sigma Aldrich) in 6 M urea, 2 M thiourea.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment focuses on identifying interactors of ZUFSP. The primary comparisons are between wild-type and catalytically inactive (C360A) ZUFSP, and between wild-type ZUFSP with and without nuclease treatment to determine DNA-dependence of interactions. Benzonase is mapped to the broad chemical_or_drug category as no specific fine-grained class for nucleases is provided in the ontology.
